items.text: Abeanakin naka ikagolok: luka Ikorakin; Meselemia okoku loka Kore, lokodwe luka Asap.
Ajaas Meselemia idwe lusap; Sekaria ekiyai, Yediaellokiareit, Sebadia lokiwuniet, Yatiniel, lokiwoŋonet;
Elam lokikanyet, Yekokanan lokikanyetekape, Eliekoenai lokikanyetekaarei.
Ajaas Obed-edom idwe lusap; Semaia ekiyai, Yekosaba lokiareit, Yoa lokiwuniet, Sakar lokiwononet, ka Netanellokikanyet;
Amiellokikanyetekape, Isakar lokikanyetekaarei, Peuletai lokikanyetekauni: naarai kisireren Edeke ŋes,
Aponi kourikinai Semaia da okokuke idwe lusap, Iukeyaito ekek loka papakee: naarai keraas ituŋa lukirigin luetitin.
Odwe luka Semaia; Otini, ka Repael, ka Obed, ka Elisabad, lukeraas iinaeanake ituŋa luetitin, Eliku, ka Semakia.
Ŋul kere odwe luka Obed-edom; kes ka odwekee ka iinaeanakee, ituŋa lukapedor ka agogoŋ aijaanakin; akaisakanykape ka luarei luka Obed-edom.
Ajaas Meselemia idwe lusap ka iinaean, ituŋa luetitin, itomon ka lukanykauni.
Kosa da, lokodwe luka Merari, ajaas ŋes idwe lusap; Simiri lokapolon (naarai abu papake kitarau ŋes lokapolon kwabo mam kerai ekiyai);
Kilikia lokiareit, Tebalia lokiwuniet, Sekaria lokiwononet: odwe ka iinaean kere luka Kosa emwaasi itomon ka luuni.
Kotoma kanul kobeanakinos ikagolok, ituŋa lukapolok, lukejaas nukisinadio, kwape kiinaeanakee, aiiaanakin kotogo loka EJAKAIT,
Apotu kilamilamata, ludidik kwape kalukapolok, kwapc ajaatar ikekia luka lukapapaakee, kanuka nolirute.
Kobeik Selemia eroet lokokide. Kosodete ailamilamikin Sekaria okokuke, ekapetan akiro lokeeobe; kobeik ekeroet ari naka agolitomei,
Kobeik Obed-edom ari naka eŋalakimak: ka odweke etogo loka ainad.
Kobeik Supim ka Kosa ari nakoto, erute loka Saleket, nekejai eititiria loedokari, kiteonoro ikedarak kaluee.
Keiaas Ilebin ikanykape ari nakokide, iwonon ninipaaran ari naka agolitomei, iwonon ninipaaran ari naka eŋalakimak, ka iareiarei kanuka etogo loka ainad,
Kanuka Parabar ari nakoto, iwonon neejai eititiria, ka iarei oParabar.
Ŋun kes abeanakineta nuka ikagolok; lukodwe luka Ikorakin, ka lukodwe luka Merari.
Luka Ilebin, kopolokinite Akiya aiŋadisia nuka etogo loka Edeke, ka aiŋadisia nuka iboro luketiakunitai,
Odwe luka Ladan; odwe luka Igeresonin lukeraas luka Ladan, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee lukeraas luka Ladan Egeresonit; Yekieli.
Odwe luka Yekieli; Setam, ka Yoel onaeeke, kopolokinito aiŋadisia nuka etogo loka EJAKAIT,
Luka Imuramain, luka Isarin, ka luka Ikeburonin, ka luka Iusielin;
Kerai Sebuel okoku loka Geresom, okoku loka Musa ekayaiton aiŋadisia.
Ka iinacanake; loka Elieser kobu Rekabia okokuke ka Yesaia okokuke, ka Yoram okokuke, ka Sikiri okokuke, ka Selemot okokuke,

Kopolokinite Selemot ŋol ka ikeinaean aiŋadisia kere nuka iboro luatiakunitai, luapotu Daudi, ka ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee, ikapolok luka ilukumin, ka lukakwatat, ka ikapolok luka aiore kotiakasi.
Luka lunatuna luadumunete koiiisio apotu kotiakasi aiteteun etogo loka EJAKAIT,
Kere da luabu Samuel ekadwaran, ka Saul okoku loka Kis, ka Abiner okoku loka Ner, ka Yoab okoku loka Seruia, kotiak; ŋinibore kere yeniketiakunitai, kerai nin yenikakan naka Selemot ka iinaeanake.
Luka Isarin, apotu Kenania ka odweke kiswamata aswam nakokina koIsirael, araut ikapolokitok ka ikatubok.
Luka Ikeburonin, Kasabia ka iinaeanake, ituŋa Iuetitiŋ, elukumit ka akwat akanykaarei, kopolokinito Isirael okekwa juwai Yorodan ari nakoto; kanuka aswam kere naka EJAKAIT, ido aijaanakin ekabaka.

Luka Ikeburonin kerai Yeriya lokapolon, loka Ikeburonin, kwape ajaar aurikee kwape ajaatar ikekia luka lukapapaakec. Kokaru loka akaisaoŋon loka airum naka Daudi aponi komoai, ido kodumunai kakesi ituŋa lukirigin luetitin koYaser loka Gilead.

Iinaeanake, ituŋa luetitin, emwaasi ilukumin iarei ka akwat akanykaarei, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee, luabu Daudi kitarau ikapolokitok luka Ireubenin, ka Igadin, ka atutubet naka ateker naka Imanasein, kaŋinikirot mama ejai Edeke, kakiro da nuka ekabaka.
